 FAQ
 Frequently Asked Questions

 Do you take a commission on entry fees? Zero percent, always. Entry fees route directly to your Stripe account via Stripe Connect — Racey never touches the money. The only fees are Stripe's standard processing rates (typically 2.9% + 30¢). Entry-fee collection is rolling out league by league — and the commission is zero from day one. This isn't a promo; it's a permanent commitment.
 Which sim platforms does Racey support? Any sim, via a CSV results file. iRacing and EA F1 23/24/25 write one you can upload directly — iRacing from the member site, EA F1 from the in-game Export Session Results button on PC. Every other sim works from a results spreadsheet: one row per driver, finishing position and driver name. iRacing also gets a deep integration (Customer ID linking, public-profile eligibility checks, and OAuth) once iRacing reopens new client signups for partner API access. See the iRacing integration workflow → 
 How does the protest and steward system work? Drivers file protests with video evidence and timestamps. Stewards receive blinded cases (no names visible), vote independently, and issue rulings with specific penalty types. Drivers can appeal, and all decisions are tracked for precedent.
 Can I migrate my existing league to Racey? Yes. We provide CSV import tools for historical results, standings, and driver rosters. The Operator Pilot program offers hands-on migration help for a limited cohort of leagues each season. See the Operator Pilot → 
 Is there a limit on the number of races per season? No. Every league supports unlimited rounds per season and unlimited concurrent seasons — there are no limits on leagues, teams, staff, or steward seats either. The one real limit is storage, capped at 1 GB per league.
 Can I use custom scoring systems? Yes — every league gets the full scoring engine, free: custom position points, configurable bonuses (pole, fastest lap, clean race, etc.), drop weeks, heat racing, stage scoring, and multi-class configurations.
 Is analytics really free? Yes. Full driver, season, and league analytics are free for every league — no paywall on your own data, and no limit that unlocks anything more.
